title: Sparkling Beverage Maker is a Great Concept, But.....
text:
Sparkling Beverage Maker is a Great Concept, But...... Carbonated beverages offer great refreshment. There is just something about the added bubbles that takes an ordinary cold beverage and makes it that much better and it isn't difficult to understand why so many people are so hooked on some of the popular soft drink brands.

So, with soft drinks tasting so refreshing, the idea of owning a small appliance that would make a great carbonated beverage tailored to one's own tastes has a definite appeal. What soft drink lover wouldn't like to create his/her own bubbly beverages? The concept is a good one and it has been done before but, unfortunately for the consumer, this Cuisinart appliance isn't as great as it first seems.

Let's start with the good aspects of the machine. It is simple to set up and use because it has only a few separate parts and it does make a good- tasting soda. You can add just a little bit of carbonation or a lot, so you can make the beverage as bubbly as you wish. Just add the carbonation, add your flavoring, and the beverage is ready to serve. The unit takes little counter space and is easy to store, too, so it is there when you need it and out of sight just as quickly.

Okay, so there are some reasons to like this appliance, but I'm afraid that the negatives are equal if not greater. For one, it should come with at least two bottles, but Cuisinart provides just a single, one- liter bottle and charges a high price to buy a second. One liter of soda doesn't last long at all in my house and that means constantly having to make more. It also doesn't make 16 bottles of soda, as it leads you to believe. Read the words carefully and you will see that the claim is that it makes up to 16 bottles. If you like your soda more carbonated like I do, then you can expect to get only about 12 bottles before you have to replace the CO2 cartridge.

And herein lies the greatest problem with this device: The cost of the replacement cartridges. At about twenty dollars a pop, with about 12 bottles created from a cartridge, the price of a single liter bottle of soda, just for the carbonation alone, is about $1.67! That's more than double the price per liter at a store and with the cost advantage eliminated, one of the greatest reasons to purchase a device like this is eliminated. Why go to so much trouble when you can get twice as much soft drink, straight from the store shelves, for the same money? I know, I know- the soft drinks you make yourself are more natural and you avoid waste because you reuse the bottles. But if the price is more than double, it is going to be difficult to convince people to make the purchase.

I like this idea in concept, but I cannot recommend the Cuisinart Sparkling Beverage Maker. The sodastream machine is better and costs less per serving, so if you really want to own a soda maker, that would be your best bet. It is nice that Cuisinart wants to help eliminate waste and help individuals consume healthier beverages, but they really need to work on the cost factor if they want this item to sell.

product_metadata.title: Cuisinart Sparkling Beverage Maker, Black
features: Operates with any size Cuisinart CO2 cartridges
Includes one CO2 cartridge that makes up to 16 liters of soda; also includes a one-liter BPA-free soda bottle
Exclusive CO2 Quick connect valve makes connecting and removing easy
Removable drip tray for easy cleaning; push-down handle for customized carbonating
Embossed Cuisinart logo with metal accents
description: Put a Sparkle into Ordinary Tap Water

Save money, save time, save space, save the planet. Do all that and more with the Cuisinart Sparkling Beverage Maker. This magic machine turns plain water into sparkling water in less than 15 seconds. Add flavorings after you carbonate for delicious homemade sodas. You control the level of carbonation; you control the sweetness. The CO2 cartridge easily snaps in to make up to 16 liters of carbonated water with the push of a lever. Get ready to enjoy the drinks you love -- seltzer, sodas, energy and sparkling cocktails.
Custom Control and Lots of Options

Make delicious soda with tap or filtered water with your own ingredients -- no salt, less sugar, more natural flavorings. Choose the carbonation level, add flavorings if desired -- even create homemade energy and party drinks. Delicious homemade recipes are included.
Hints and Tips
The Chill Factor

To get the best bubbles, be sure to use the coldest water possible. Store the carbonating bottles filled with fresh, filtered water in the refrigerator so they are ready to go when you are. Simple syrup can keep in the refrigerator for up to one month. Make a big batch so you can whip up drinks at any time.
To Each Their Own

You decide how much fizz you want in your drink. Some prefer water with their bubbles, while others prefer bubbles to dominate the water -- you be the judge. The more times you press, the more bubbles are being forced into your water.
Beverage Variety

Make your morning fizz by adding some carbonated water to freshly squeezed orange or grapefruit juice. For a sweet finish, try out a root beer or cola float. For the after 5 o'clock crowd, let the Cuisinart Sparkling Beverage Maker be a fixture on your bar at home. From fizzy mojitos to big bowls of spritzy wine punches, carbonated cocktails make a statement.
Easy as 1, 2, 3
1. Open the back and slip in the quick-connect CO2 cartridge 2. Insert the BPA-free bottle and twist into place 3. Press and release the handle to reach your desired carbonation level
Desired Carbonation

A pump is a two-second burst of pressure on the handle, leaving a few seconds in between each burst. To achieve an average level of carbonation, three pumps are recommended. To get a stronger carbonation level, simply pump again to add more CO2.
Features
Single Pump Operation:
Features a push-down handle that carbonates water in seconds, to the level you like. No batteries or electricity required.
Recyclable CO2 cartridge:
The exclusive quick-connect design slips into your Sparkling Beverage Maker to carbonate water.
Reusable BPA-free 1-Liter Bottle:
Simply fill with water, attach to the machine, carbonate and seal with the airtight cap. No more lugging heavy cans and bottles home or returning them to recycle.
Removable Drip Tray:
Empties and rinses out quickly for easy cleanup.
Flavor Options:
Turn sparkling water into flavored soda with fresh juice or prepackaged flavors. Make seltzer, energy drinks or sparkling cocktails.
Sleek Design:
The Sparkling Beverage Maker fits in small spaces with assorted color options that complement any home.
Cleanup Made Easy
Wipe down the beverage maker with a damp sponge, cloth or paper towel. The removable drip tray keeps cleanup simple. Be sure to hand wash the beverage bottle and cap following each use.
